role_policy.multi_role: Store separate evidence-backed functional roles as an array. Do not force a unique destination from provenance alone; a boss drop may also be gear, a resource, a tool, or clue equipment.
role_policy.provenance: Record source activity and formal Collection Log membership as provenance flags, not as automatic destinations.
role_policy.slayer_boss_activity: Assign activity/loot role only when Wiki page category or text identifies a functional association (drop, reward, task equipment, task utility, or bossing use). Separate usable combat gear, supplies, and resources from trophies and low-use loot.
role_policy.quest_items: Quest association or the Wiki Quest item property is a provenance/quest-use flag. Preserve items with a repeatable or post-quest function in their functional category. Do not label every quest-associated item as cleanup. Quest association and the Quest items category alone do not prove post-quest reuse; a retained function needs separate item-page evidence.
role_policy.clue_requirements: Require direct evidence of use in an emote clue/Charlie task/other clue step, preferably an exact Wiki category or guide list. Keep broad clue preparation utilities (spade, teleports, energy supplies) in their normal utility/supplies roles while marking clue relevance when direct evidence exists. Do not infer from clue-themed names.
role_policy.clue_rewards: Use reward-table/category evidence to mark clue reward provenance. Assign the item's functional destination too (gear, cosmetic, resource, clue reward); reward provenance alone does not make it a clue requirement. Preserve an evidenced gear, tool, resource, or cosmetic role; clue-reward provenance is separate from clue-step requirements.
role_policy.collection_log: Represent formal Collection Log inclusion independently from personal collectibility. CL inclusion is not equivalent to cosmetic, unique usefulness, or clue role; absence from known CL sources is not negative proof. Formal item links and activity section headings provide exact listed-entry/source evidence; activity provenance is not destination or user collection preference.
role_policy.pets_trophies: A Wiki-confirmed pet/trophy or display/cosmetic function may justify a collectible role. Keep utility-bearing pets/items in all evidenced roles. Personal collection preference is user-specific and must not imply cleanup.
role_policy.cleanup: Only make a cleanup candidate when evidence supports no active, reusable, combat, clue, skilling, quest, storage, or personal collection function, and retain uncertainty where sources are incomplete. Wiki absence or a generic cleanup category alone is insufficient.

evidence_order: exact item page infobox and article body
exact Wiki category membership (including clue requirements, clue rewards, Slayer equipment, activity/Collection Log categories)
official Wiki guide or reward/drop list naming the exact item
repository catalog inference for candidate discovery only

source_pages.supports: Slayer equipment is functionally defined by use against Slayer monsters, including protective equipment, task finishers, and boosts. Individual category membership may need a page-level qualification.
Exact item category for items required by at least one emote clue; category states 379 pages.
STASH units store emote clue items and can save bank space and bank trips.
Clue trails require specific held/equipped items and general prep utilities; clue rewards are a separate outcome.
Collection Log records most unique drops; the same item can share slots across multiple source pages. Membership records provenance, not a unique storage destination.
Exact Wiki category membership is direct clue-step requirement evidence; it is page-level and must be treated separately from Treasure Trails reward membership.
Direct Treasure Trails reward provenance; reward membership does not establish that the item is required to complete a clue.
Wiki page category for formal Collection Log items. Membership is a log fact; player storage preference is separate.
Items storable in costume-room storage; informs retained storage and cosmetic roles without requiring a cleanup inference.
Wiki pet designation; personal collecting and bank placement remain player-specific.
Formal Collection Log source sections; audit extracted only linked item names from structured activity tables, retaining activity heading as provenance.

collection_log_method.extraction: Parse {{plink|Item}} links only after ==Bosses== and before the closing {{Collection log}} transclusion; capture current section headings as provenance.
collection_log_method.matching: Normalize spaces and underscores and case-fold; match exact item page titles only.
collection_log_method.limitation: Some Wiki category members did not title-match a formal table link. Neither case is used as absence proof; duplicate row IDs may point to the same item page.

review_metrics.metric_meaning: These rows have at least one positive Wiki/function/provenance signal and a CLEANUP catalog baseline or effective cleanup tag. This is a review queue, not proof of reusable post-quest function, desirable retention, or a destination.
review_metrics.manual_review_status: Mechanical full-catalog candidate review; priority examples are source-checked, but the complete queue was not manually adjudicated.

provenance_vs_destination_policy: Keep activity source, quest association, clue requirement/reward source, and Collection Log membership as distinct evidence fields. These facts do not choose a layout destination on their own.
